result.title: Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC): A Mechanism for Time-Aware Pediatric Sleep Representation Learning
result.summary: Sleep physiology evolves throughout the night, with changes in sleep cycles, respiratory stability, and cardiovascular dynamics. However, self-supervised learning (SSL) methods for sleep typically process short, fixed-duration windows without explicitly modeling where each window occurs within the full sleep session. We introduce Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC), a mechanism that complements local positional encodings by conditioning latent representations on the global time-of-sleep of each input window. We integrate GTC into three representative SSL frameworks and evaluate them on five clinically relevant tasks with extreme class imbalance across two independent pediatric cohorts. GTC generally improves F1 and AUPRC across architectures and tasks, with gains persisting under cross-cohort transfer, highlighting the value of global temporal context for sleep representation learning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Global Time-Aware Conditioning（GTC），在局部位置编码之外用「睡眠全局时间」对 latent 表示做条件化，并把它接入三种 SSL 框架，在两个儿科队列的五项任务上评估，F1 与 AUPRC 普遍提升且跨队列迁移仍有效。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把全局时间位置注入 latent 的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的位置/深度条件化以及内容与位置对表示的影响提供可核查线索，但领域为睡眠生理信号，迁移属推测。
